Settings.UiLanguageHint: Agentic DJ panel only. Auto follows Foundry's language (English, 繁體中文, 简体中文, 日本語).
Settings.DefaultsBanner: Empty fields fall back to the shipped defaults. Reset sampling restores temperature 0.4, max tokens 900, top P 1, cooldown 20s, and 3 proposals.
Settings.SamplingIntro: These control a tool-using DJ, not a novelist. Defaults bias toward stable function calls and cheap replies.
Settings.LlmTemperatureHint: Default 0.4. Low enough that tool names and soundIds stay stable; high enough that two combat cues are not clones. 0 is brittle JSON. 1+ invents tracks.
Settings.LlmMaxTokensHint: Default 900. Covers a 6-step tool loop (context + search + verify + propose) without paying for essay-length chat. Librarian cards are tiny; this budget is for the Director.
Settings.LlmTopPHint: Default 1. Temperature already caps chaos. Cutting top P on top of 0.4 temperature over-prunes and drops valid tool calls. Leave at 1 unless a provider misbehaves.
Settings.ExtraInstructionsHint: Default empty. Campaign-specific taste belongs here, not in temperature. The agents already have a system prompt.
Settings.AutoAnalyzeHint: Default on for small libraries. Skipped when more than 8 tracks are pending so Foundry does not freeze on decode. Use Manual list for large playlists.
Settings.CooldownHint: Default 20s. Combat/chat hooks fire often. Shorter than this burns tokens and flickers the GM panel.
Settings.MaxProposalsHint: Default 3. Two is a false choice, four is a picker. The GM must confirm; this is not a playlist dump.
Settings.DefaultsRestored: Sampling and table defaults restored (API keys untouched).
Settings.KeyMissing: No key saved yet. Paste one and click Save. Keys never leave this browser.
Settings.KeyPlaceholderSaved: Leave blank to keep the saved key
